name: homebase-new-project
title_zh: 新项目开工前替你问完该问的
tagline_zh: 说声“新项目”它就开始盘问：仓库名、许可证、默认分支——问完自动建仓、写 CLAUDE.md。
tagline_en: Say "new project" and it interrogates you on repo name, license, default branch—then creates the GitHub repo.
desc_en: Start a brand-new project the HomeBase way. Use when the user says "new project", "start a repo", "set up a project", "create a new app", or opens an empty folder and wants it wired up. Asks the few questions only they can answer, then creates the GitHub repo, the short CLAUDE.md, the sharded CI, the two watchers, branch protection and the INDEX row, and proves it with a green first run.
why_zh: 不是模板堆砌，而是把“开工仪式”压缩成一次对话：它只问只有你能答的，其余全部替你决定并落地。
why_en: It compresses the project kickoff ritual into one conversation: asks only what only you know, decides the rest, and verifies the.
limit_zh: 只认 GitHub 远端，不碰 GitLab/Gitea；需要本机已装 gh CLI 并登录；只搭骨架不写业务代码。
limit_en: GitHub only; requires gh CLI installed and authenticated; scaffolds infrastructure, not business code; won't overwrite existing workflow files.
title_en: Ask the few questions only you can answer, then wire up.
